about: pf-logging, 13 Oct 2026. Farkas (LP-dual) certificates for b4-depth4's family-S integer programmes, valid for EVERY block size m. Each constraint is a linear form g >= 0 in the listed variables and m (key '1' = constant term). A certificate is a list of nonnegative multipliers lambda_i such that  objective - sum_i lambda_i g_i  is identically a nonnegative constant. Then objective >= 0 at every feasible point, for every m.
variables: a, a2: depths of the shared lineage's two parents (x in T1, y in T2); c, r1, r2: common prefix and branches of the shared lineage; dJ: junk depth; s1, s2: sizes of the pure trees T1, T2; dpar1 (>= a), dpar2 (>= a2): depth of the parent node in its tree; dz1, dz2: depth of the covering node (pure cover z) or of the lineage node y_f (lineage cover); L1, L2: depth of the lowest common ancestor in the Steiner tree; dist1, dist2: tree distance; q1, q2: lineage moves for J1, J2 (0 for a pure cover); lin: lineage cost charged (max(q1,q2) if both > 0, else q1 + q2); n: total moves

ip2.file: wave16/b4-depth4/familyS_ip2.py (the residual case behind 'FAMILY S CLOSED')
ip2.objective_meaning: n - 2m >= 0, where n = s1 + s2 + c + r1 + r2 + lin (the program's n)

def_n.source: n = s1 + s2 + base + lin, base = c + r1 + r2

T1_size.source: s1 = steiner(dpar1, dz1, dist1) = dpar1 + dz1 - L1 (J2 cover on T1, pure or lineage)

T1_par.source: dpar ranges over range(d_par, ...) with d_par = a for T1

T2_size.source: s2 = steiner(dpar2, dz2, dist2) = dpar2 + dz2 - L2 (J1 cover on T2)

T2_dJ.source: pure: dz >= dJ (q1 = 0); lineage: q1 + dyf >= dJ

T2_K.source: pure: dist + a >= m (q1 = 0); lineage: q1 + dist + a >= m

lin_q1.source: lin = max(q1,q2) if q1,q2 > 0 else q1 + q2; either way >= q1 (q1, q2 >= 0)

ip1.file: wave16/b4-depth4/familyS_ip.py (junk cancelled by pure nodes on both sides)
ip1.objective_meaning: n - 2m - 1 >= 0, where n = s1 + s2 + c + r1 + r2

def_n.source: n = t1 + t2 + c + r1 + r2

T1_K.source: dx + dz - 2L >= m - other, other = a2 for T1
